title: The Profitability Dashboard — Building Your First Five-Year Ratio Stack

A12.value: Write 4-5 sentences identifying: (1) highest-quality business, (2) most cyclical, (3) asset-lightest, (4) best long-term compounder.

Dashboard!A13.formula_pattern: Narrative identifying business quality, cyclicality, asset efficiency, and recommendation
Dashboard!A13.expected_value: Asian Paints emerges as the highest-quality business with ROCE stability (26-30%) and operating margins of 15-18%, hallmarks of a durable-moat compounder. Tata Steel exhibits cyclical volatility—ROE and ROCE swung wildly from FY20 (7%, 12%) to FY22 (31%, 32%)—reflecting steel's commodity-driven capital intensity. Infosys stands as the asset-lightest player: its reported ROCE of 26-36% masks exceptional true operating returns exceeding 40% when cash is excluded, exemplifying tech services' capital-efficient model. For long-term wealth creation, Asian Paints is the conviction buy, with Infosys as a high-quality alternative; Tata Steel suits only disciplined cycle investors.
